consistency_groups.group: Self references inside a reflexive "When you do" body
consistency_groups.review_requirement: Preserve creator/source, granted holder and the reflexive action subject. Review the exact reflexive frame; no blanket Source/EventSubject alias.

consistency_groups.group: "You may <action>." followed by sentences that depend on it
consistency_groups.review_requirement: Previous delayed-trigger review intentionally retained guarded payment registration for Dawn, Mirror and Ilharg. Do not undo those decisions from representation frequency alone.

consistency_groups.group: Random return from a graveyard to a hand
consistency_groups.review_requirement: Chance selection and an AtRandom choice can both express random return. Compare cardinality and batch/population before selecting a normal form.

consistency_groups.group: A targeted object's pronoun inside a delayed trigger
consistency_groups.review_requirement: Delayed Turn events have no object subject of their own. Prove whether EventSubject captures the outer trigger or is unbound; preserve exact target identity and capture lifetime.

consistency_groups.group: "Another" in a compound "enters or attacks" self-trigger
consistency_groups.review_requirement: When both alternative events are explicitly self events, their distinguished object may be the same source. Check granted ability-holder context separately.

consistency_groups.group: "If it's a <type> card" after a one-card exile
consistency_groups.review_requirement: Before and After movement views can differ under replacements and characteristic changes. The exact sentence and actual receipt, not control frequency, determine which view is correct.

consistency_groups.group: "Untap those creatures" after a per-opponent control change
consistency_groups.review_requirement: Named target and affected receipt may coincide. A failed control-change witness must establish whether the receipt names attempted or successful objects before replacing it.

consistency_groups.group: A type added to a returned creature
consistency_groups.review_requirement: Arrival changes versus a later continuous effect can be semantically different (entry-event characteristics). Review wording and entry replacement witnesses per card; do not flatten all animations.

consistency_groups.group: A property of a single result
consistency_groups.review_requirement: A scalar property and a sum can coincide only for a proven singular population. Preserve zero-case semantics and genuinely plural receipts.

consistency_groups.group: The last-known state of a sacrificed fixed object
consistency_groups.review_requirement: Last-known sacrificed source, event subject and Before transition can coincide only with the exact original incarnation and an explicitly captured last-known view.

consistency_groups.group: "This card" after the card exiled itself
consistency_groups.review_requirement: Post-cost or post-exile incarnation and expected-zone constraints matter. Kogla demonstrates why a generic Source substitution can be incorrect.

consistency_groups.group: The subject of a block-pair event on one card
consistency_groups.review_requirement: BlockPair Attacker and EventSubject require event-role-specific binding; a mirrored attack/block pair can legitimately use different roles.

consistency_groups.group: Operand order of "N life more than your starting life total"
consistency_groups.review_requirement: Addition order for a pair of integer quantities is a normal-form issue, subject to the same arithmetic overflow/saturation semantics; not a card-rules error solely from spelling.
